justification.backwardCompatibleAlternativeSummary: Carry forward TestReport, and likely TestScript, in R6 as deprecated or low-maturity instead of removing the resource immediately.
justification.alternativeTradeoffSummary: This would preserve validation and code generation continuity, but would keep obsolete testing resources, bindings, and support expectations visible in core.
justification.justificationRationaleMd: The likely goal--retiring an immature TestReport/TestScript execution-reporting model from R6 core--is reasonable, and full removal is probably reasonable because R4 `TestReport` was draft/FMM 0 and tightly depends on `TestScript`, which is also absent from the local R6 package. However, the local inputs do not include the official ballot rationale, and a less-breaking carry-forward path existed, so the break is assessed as probably rather than conclusively justified.
justification.backwardCompatibleAlternativeMd: The best less-breaking base R6 design would have been to keep the R4 `TestReport` StructureDefinition in R6 as deprecated, low-maturity, or not recommended for new use. To preserve R4 instances cleanly, this would likely also need to retain the related `TestScript` target and associated testing terminology/search surface, because `TestReport.testScript` was mandatory in R4. That alternative is not merely migration tooling and would preserve most or all R4-valid instances, but it is only a partial alternative because it materially conflicts with a goal of removing the testing resource family from core and could imply ongoing support for a model the work group no longer intends to maintain.
